selection_source.role: interval selection only; never substituted for spacecraft-specific MAG input

eligibility.coverage_revision_reason: the first preselection run showed that no day in the frozen OMNI search pool had 95 percent finite flow-speed coverage; before any spacecraft gate date was selected, the speed requirement was declared as 70 percent while F and SYM_H remain at 95 percent

ranking.quiet_rule: lowest rank sum after eligibility and spacing
ranking.moderate_rule: closest to the eligible rank-sum median after removing quiet selections and applying spacing

fixed_event_controls.selection_basis: frozen development event already audited by NVCPP
NASA CCMC DONKI quality-2 clear signature selected before gate retrieval
NASA CCMC DONKI quality-1 glancing arrival selected before gate retrieval

selection_limits: the OMNI composite is used only to select low- and middle-activity dates, not to calculate spacecraft gates
low-activity and moderate labels are relative to this frozen search pool, not universal solar-wind classes
no spacecraft-specific gate output may be inspected before the selected dates are written
fixed event controls are selected from external NASA event metadata before gate retrieval
dates may not be replaced because their later gate result is inconvenient
the 70 percent flow-speed coverage gate was declared after a zero-eligible-day transport diagnostic and before any spacecraft gate output was retrieved
